identity.title: First Detection of CS Masers around a High-mass Young Stellar Object, W51 e2e

paper_type_evidence.quote: We report the discovery of maser emission in the two lowest rotational transitions of CS toward the high-mass protostar W51 e2e with ALMA and the JVLA.

evidence.quote: The W51 A high-mass star-forming region (at a distance of 5.4 kpc - (cite: Sato2010a))

question.value: Do the CS J=1-0 and J=2-1 rotational transitions show maser emission toward high-mass protostars in W51 A, and where do they arise?

evidence.quote: We report here the first detection of maser emission from CS $v=0$ in both the J=1-0 and J=2-1 transitions in W51 e2e and nondetections in the other two hot cores.

analysis_steps.goal: Infer enclosed mass from maser separation

method.value: Assume masers at opposite ends of an orbiting disk, v_orb=15 km/s, R=95 AU

evidence.quote: assuming the masers come from opposite ends of a disk such that $v_{orb}=15\pm1$ km s$^{-1}$ and $R_{disk}=95\pm30$ AU

evidence.quote: In that case, the orbital analysis is not valid.

findings_qualitative.value: CS 1-0 and 2-1 masers are spatially and spectrally offset; both near the base of the blueshifted outflow

evidence.quote: but both appear to come from the base of the blueshifted outflow from this source

claims.hypothesis: CS rotational lines in W51 e2e are masers
claims.experiment: Imaged CS 1-0 (VLA) and 2-1 (ALMA) and measured brightness temperatures and velocities
claims.result: Peak brightness ~7000 K, lines at different velocities and positions

evidence.quote: This is the first reported detection of maser emission from CS.

claims.hypothesis: Other W51 HMYSOs also host CS masers
claims.experiment: Searched IRS2/North and e8 in same data
claims.result: No compact bright CS, limit 15 mJy/beam

evidence.quote: No compact and bright CS emission sources were detected toward either of these HMYSO candidates

claims.hypothesis: Masers trace a disk around a central mass
claims.experiment: Orbital mass from velocity and spatial separation
claims.finding: Possible but outflow origin not excluded

evidence.quote: However, the velocity separation also hints that these masers may be produced in the outflow rather than in a disk.

alternatives_considered_or_rejected.value: Thermal origin rejected because of different velocities of the peaks and high brightness temperature

evidence.quote: This velocity difference rules out a thermal origin for either transition

limitations_admitted.value: Spectral resolution too coarse to identify lines narrower than thermal width

evidence.quote: our observations have too coarse resolution to identify such narrow widths if they are present.
so our systematic pointing error is approximately 0.003(16 AU).
